title: 通过一致性驱动强化学习提升跨语言事实召回能力
summary: 提出PolyFact多语言事实QA数据集（100K条，12种语言），对比CPT、SFT和GRPO三种方法，发现GRPO在跨语言一致性和泛化上优于SFT，并能重组多语言路由，减少语言专化。
summary_en: Introduces PolyFact, a multilingual factual QA dataset (100K facts, 12 languages). Compares CPT, SFT, and GRPO; GRPO outperforms SFT in cross-lingual consistency and generalization, reorganizing multilingual routing by reducing language specialization.
